title: Minecraft Series
statementMd:
Little Misha goes to the programming club and solves nothing there. It may seem strange, but when you find out that Misha is filming a Minecraft series, everything will fall into place...

Misha is inspired by Manhattan, so he built a city in Minecraft that can be imagined as a table of size $n \times m$. $k$ students live in a city, the $i$-th student lives in the house, located at the intersection of the $x_i$-th row and the $y_i$-th column. Also, each student has a degree of his aggressiveness $w_i$. Since the city turned out to be very large, Misha decided to territorially limit the actions of his series to some square $s$, which sides are parallel to the coordinate axes. The length of the side of the square should be an integer from $1$ to $\min(n, m)$ cells.

According to the plot, the main hero will come to the city and accidentally fall into the square $s$. Possessing a unique degree of aggressiveness $0$, he will be able to show his leadership qualities and assemble a team of calm, moderate and aggressive students.

In order for the assembled team to be versatile and close-knit, degrees of aggressiveness of all students of the team must be pairwise distinct and must form a single segment of consecutive integers. Formally, if **there exist** students with degrees of aggressiveness $l, l+1, \ldots, -1, 1, \ldots, r-1, r$ inside the square $s$, where $l \le 0 \le r$, the main hero will be able to form a team of $r-l+1$ people (of course, he is included in this team).

**Notice**, that it is not required to take all students from square $s$ to the team.

Misha thinks that the team should consist of at least $t$ people. That is why he is interested, how many squares are there in the table in which the main hero will be able to form a team of at least $t$ people. Help him to calculate this.

## Input

The first line contains four integers $n$, $m$, $k$ and $t$ ($1 \le n, m \le 40\,000$, $1 \le n \cdot m \le 40\,000$, $1 \le k \le 10^6$, $1 \le t \le k + 1$) — the number of rows and columns in the table, and the number of students living in the city, respectively.

Each of the following $k$ lines contains three integers $x_i$, $y_i$ and $w_i$ ($1 \le x_i \le n$, $1 \le y_i \le m$, $1 \le \lvert w_i \rvert \le 10^9$) — the number of row and column, where the $i$-th student is living, and the degree of his aggressiveness.

## Output

Print one integer — the number of ways to choose the square $s$ in such way that the main hero will be able to form a team of at least $t$ people.

## Note

1. In the first example the main hero will not be able to form a team of more than one person in any square $s$. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ab3bc6355fccd0a705099d065c8fca5065cc2d1f.png) Illustration for the first example.
2. In the second example there are two ways to select square $s$. Both of them are illustrated below. In one of them the main hero will be able to form a team of students with degrees of aggressiveness $[0, 1]$, and in the another — with degrees of aggressiveness $[0, 1, 2]$. Notice, that the main hero with degree of aggressiveness $0$ will be included to the team regardless of the chosen square. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5cade6ee4ac5af526acfa95fd94caba4d25f0c05.png) Illustration for the second example.
3. In the third example there are four ways to select square $s$. All of them are illustrated below. The main hero will be able to form a team with degrees of aggressiveness: $[-1,0,1]$, $[0,1]$, $[0,1]$, $[-1, 0, 1]$, respectively. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b79010e89a6b630e77b714664e618f879ba8854f.png) Illustration for the third example.
statementZhMd:
小米沙去编程俱乐部，却什么也不解决。这看起来可能很奇怪，但当你得知米沙正在拍摄 Minecraft 系列后，一切就都说得通了……

米沙受到曼哈顿的启发，在 Minecraft 中建造了一座城市，可以将其想象成一个大小为 $n \times m$ 的表格。城市中住着 $k$ 名学生，第 $i$ 名学生住在第 $x_i$ 行与第 $y_i$ 列交汇处的房屋中。此外，每名学生都有一个表示其攻击性的数值 $w_i$。由于城市实在太大了，米沙决定将系列的活动范围限制在某个正方形 $s$ 内，该正方形的边与坐标轴平行。正方形的边长必须是 $1$ 到 $\min(n, m)$ 个格子之间的整数。

按照剧情，主角将来到这座城市，并意外地掉进正方形 $s$ 中。凭借其独特的攻击性数值 $0$，他能够展现自己的领导才能，组建一支由平静、适中和具有攻击性的学生组成的队伍。

为了使组建的队伍全面且团结，队伍中所有学生的攻击性数值必须两两不同，并且必须构成一个连续整数段。形式化地说，如果正方形 $s$ 内 **存在** 攻击性数值为 $l, l+1, \ldots, -1, 1, \ldots, r-1, r$ 的学生，其中 $l \le 0 \le r$，那么主角就能组建一支人数为 $r-l+1$ 的队伍（当然，主角也包括在队伍中）。

**注意**，不要求将正方形 $s$ 内的所有学生都加入队伍。

米沙认为队伍至少应由 $t$ 人组成。因此，他想知道表格中有多少个正方形，使得主角能够组建一支至少有 $t$ 人的队伍。请帮助他计算这个数量。

## 输入格式

第一行包含四个整数 $n$、$m$、$k$ 和 $t$（$1 \le n, m \le 40\,000$，$1 \le n \cdot m \le 40\,000$，$1 \le k \le 10^6$，$1 \le t \le k + 1$）——表格的行数和列数、城市中居住的学生人数，以及队伍所需的最少人数。

接下来的 $k$ 行中，每行包含三个整数 $x_i$、$y_i$ 和 $w_i$（$1 \le x_i \le n$，$1 \le y_i \le m$，$1 \le \lvert w_i \rvert \le 10^9$）——第 $i$ 名学生所在的行号和列号，以及他的攻击性数值。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——选择正方形 $s$ 的方案数，使得主角能够组建一支至少有 $t$ 人的队伍。

## 说明

1. 在第一个样例中，主角在任何正方形 $s$ 中都无法组建超过 1 人的队伍。![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ab3bc6355fccd0a705099d065c8fca5065cc2d1f.png) 第一个样例的示意图。
2. 在第二个样例中，有两种选择正方形 $s$ 的方式。下图展示了这两种方式。在其中一种方式中，主角能够组建攻击性数值为 $[0, 1]$ 的学生队伍；在另一种方式中，主角能够组建攻击性数值为 $[0, 1, 2]$ 的学生队伍。注意，无论选择哪个正方形，攻击性数值为 $0$ 的主角都会被加入队伍。![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5cade6ee4ac5af526acfa95fd94caba4d25f0c05.png) 第二个样例的示意图。
3. 在第三个样例中，有四种选择正方形 $s$ 的方式。下图展示了所有方式。主角分别能够组建攻击性数值为 $[-1,0,1]$、$[0,1]$、$[0,1]$、$[-1, 0, 1]$ 的队伍。![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b79010e89a6b630e77b714664e618f879ba8854f.png) 第三个样例的示意图。
